plan.title: Award All Units to Non-Lowest Bidder

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with two bids in Master QCS.
Open the awarding page for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 units to Vendor A, the non-lowest bidder.
Verify one line is selected, one of two vendors is awarded, and the proposal total is 10 × 100 = 1,000.
Create and submit the proposal for the allocation to Vendor A.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted without an approval step.
Complete downstream award processing and create the purchase order.
Verify the PO contains the awarded line with all 10 units.
